scope: GOLD 2023 executive summary, including replacement of groups C and D by group E and initial therapy for group E.

keyRecommendations.text: GOLD 2023 keeps groups A and B and merges former groups C and D into group E for exacerbations.
Initial therapy for group E is LAMA+LABA, except when blood eosinophils are at least 300 cells/μL, when starting triple therapy can be considered.

clinicalBottomLine: Assess COPD with the ABE tool. For frequent exacerbators (group E), start LAMA+LABA unless the blood eosinophil count is at least 300 cells/μL, when triple therapy can be considered.
notableCaveats: Symptom and exacerbation thresholds are said to be unchanged, but the figure itself is not reproduced as a table in the extract.
